description: An agent-to-agent call failed? Pass the `failure` ({code, detail}; codes: SCHEMA_MISMATCH, AUTH_REQUIRED, TIMEOUT, TASK_NOT_COMPLETED, UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL) and get a diagnosis, a concrete repair step and a receipt. Proposal only; GAIP does not touch the other system. Free, read-only, no account. Inputs must be public and non-personal; calling declares that (data_classification defaults to PUBLIC).

counterparty_id.description: Name or URL of the agent/service. Optional.

protocol.description: Counterparty protocol. Inferred from metadata when omitted, otherwise MCP.

name: gaip_diagnose_integration_failure
title: Diagnose integration failure
